biotools.name: cTTN
biotools.description: cTTN is a set of R scripts for analyzing genetic constraint in the TTN gene by adjusting for sequencing depth and calculating constraint metrics with confidence intervals. It includes tools for obtaining observed and expected variant counts from gnomAD exome data.
